recent_material_fixes.result: Normal and post-success return actions close selected-tour checkout, restore focus/scroll to the originating result or results fallback, and preserve sort/comparison state. Dedicated mobile/desktop browser regression plus all relevant visual/runtime gates and both production deploys passed.

Late lead success/error for a previous tour no longer changes the newly selected tour form; current-tour outcomes remain visible and the external lead mechanism is unchanged. All 15 PR gates and both production deploys passed.
Flight variants without a calculated price now say 'Цена уточняется' instead of rendering a bare currency symbol; priced variants are unchanged. All 12 PR gates passed.
Switching from a priced flight to a pending-price flight no longer leaves the previous flight amount visible; base tour/search price and pending-price context are restored.
An open comparison closes if refreshed results prune the selection below two hotels while the remaining tray selection is preserved.
Lowest-price and best-rating badges are suppressed during progressive search and computed only against completed result sets.
Completed main/continue searches retry result fetching against the existing searchId without restarting Tourvisor work.
Date widening clamps departure start to local today for near-term searches.
Transient intermediate result-fetch errors no longer abort healthy status polling.
